# Kamarin Lee

> Independent researcher working on verification and provenance in financial data:
> what it should take for a number to be trusted when the underlying records are hard to reach.

Kamarin Lee is an independent researcher based in the United States. His work covers data
engineering, data architecture, machine learning, and the governance layers underneath them,
applied to financial data and regulatory filings. His applied work in media-mix modeling is
featured in Wiley's Data Science For Dummies. He is not raising capital and does not sell data.

## Research areas
- Verification standards for filing data: provenance to primary sources, per-field status,
  confidence labeling, versioned processing, published error rates.
- Stated versus revealed behavior in public regulatory filings (pre-registered, embargoed).
- Measurement under partial records: bounding what is unobserved rather than estimating past it.

## Writing
- What "Verified" Should Mean (August 2026): https://kamarinlee.com/essays/what-verified-should-mean/
